stories.title: Microsoft updates smaller Surface Pro and Laptop with Qualcomm's X2 Plus chip

stories.whyItMatters: The move shows Microsoft and Qualcomm are still pushing Arm-based Windows PCs against Intel and Apple.

stories.title: Eight Sleep launches smaller Pod 6, starting at $1,999

stories.whyItMatters: It shows the connected sleep-tech market is expanding into smaller households, a growth bet for the category.

Watch for competitor moves in the smart-mattress market.

stories.title: YouTube adds AI-powered feeds and new creator tools
stories.summary: YouTube is rolling out custom AI feeds and a wave of creator tools, including conversational video editing, A/B testing, dynamic thumbnails, and live dubbing, according to Ars Technica and TechCrunch. The platform is also making comments more interactive and adding ways for creators to earn more from fandom.
stories.whyItMatters: YouTube's push shows AI features are becoming central to how the biggest video platform competes for creators and viewers.
whatToWatch: Watch for the full AI feed rollout later this year.
Watch how creators use the new editing and testing tools.
Watch for creator earnings tied to the new fandom features.
questions: When exactly does the custom feed roll out?
Will creators pay for any of these new tools?
